Awesome Mac

This project is dedicated to collecting high-quality macOS software and organizing them systematically by different categories for easy search and use. As it continues to grow, the project has far exceeded our initial expectations and has become more comprehensive and refined.

Feel free to star ⭐ and fork 🍴 to support the project!

If you have any suggestions, ideas, or discover excellent software, feel free to submit a PR to help improve this list. Please read the contributing guidelines before contributing. We also welcome you to continue following this awesome list to build a better macOS tool collection together.

Reading and Writing Tools

Applications to edit text, I suggest the open-source editors

Text Editors

  • Aurora Editor - Lightweight Code Editor (IDE) for macOS.
  • Bootstrap Studio - A powerful desktop app for creating responsive websites using the Bootstrap framework.
  • Brackets - A modern, open source text editor that understands web design.
  • CodeEdit - A lightweight, natively-built editor. Open source. Free forever.
  • CotEditor - Lightweight plain-text editor for macOS.
  • Cursor - AI code editor with autocomplete, chat, and coding agent features.
  • Emacs - Popular Unix-based text editor for programmers and system administrators.
  • Haystack Editor - Code editor with a canvas UI for better code understanding.
  • Helix - A post-modern modal text editor.
  • Itsypad - A tiny, fast scratchpad and clipboard manager for macOS.
  • Lapce - Lightning-fast and powerful code editor.
  • LightTable - The next generation code editor.
  • LiteEdit - Fast, native macOS code editor under 1 MB — Swift and AppKit, no Electron.
  • MacVim - the text editor Vim - for macOS.
  • micro - Modern and intuitive terminal-based text editor.
  • Neovim - Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability.
  • Nova - The beautiful, fast, flexible, native Mac code editor from Panic.
  • Plain Text Editor - Simple distraction-free notepad.
  • Sublime Text - Text editor with a fast interface and plugin ecosystem. For more plugins, check Sublime Text Plugins.
  • SubEthaEdit - Powerful editor for writing, coding, and collaboration anytime, anywhere!
  • TextMate - Editor that brings Apple's approach to operating systems into the world of text editors.
  • Tot - Tot is an elegant, simple way to collect & edit text. It’s your tiny text companion!
  • Vim - An old terminal-based editor. For common plugins, check Vim Common Plugins.
  • Vimr - Refined Vim Experience for OS X.
  • Windsurf - AI code editor with agentic coding, autocomplete, and MCP support.
  • Zed - A high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.

Office

  • Keynote - Build stunning presentations.
  • LibreOffice - Free, open-source office software used and tested daily by a large community.
  • Microsoft Office - Unmistakably Office, designed for Mac.
  • Numbers - Create impressive spreadsheets.
  • OnlyOffice - Office suite with document, spreadsheet, and presentation editors.
  • Pages - Documents that stand apart.
  • SoftMaker Office - A complete office suite that aims for full compatibility with Microsoft Office documents.
  • WPS - Is a cross-platform office software suite.

Markdown Tools

  • Archimedes - Native macOS Markdown editor geared toward mathematical writing with inline LaTeX support.
  • Edmund - Minimal, native macOS Markdown editor with live preview; works with your existing files, no vault.
  • EME - Open-source Markdown editor with an interface like Chrome.
  • iA Writer - Writing app with an emphasis on simplicity and design.
  • Imark - Open-source Markdown reader that stores your comments inside the document itself as HTML comments.
  • LightPaper - Simple, beautiful, yet powerful text editor for your Mac.
  • MacDown - Open source Markdown editor for macOS with live preview and HTML/PDF export.
  • Marked 2 - This is the Markdown preview with an elegant and powerful set of tools for all writers.
  • MarkText - Next generation markdown editor, running on platforms of MacOS Windows and Linux.
  • MarkViewer - Markdown viewer and editor for macOS with AI-assisted editing.
  • Marp - Markdown presentation writer with cross-platform support.
  • Marxico - Delicate Markdown editor for Evernote. Reliable storage and sync.
  • MWeb - Pro Markdown writing, and static blog generator App.
  • Obsidian - A second brain, for you, forever.
  • Pixley Reader - Reader for Markdown specs, docs, and changelogs generated by AI tools.
  • Scratch - Lightweight, offline-first markdown notes app with WYSIWYG editing and local AI agent support.
  • Typora - Truly minimal Markdown editor featuring seamless live preview.
  • Ulysses - The Ultimate Writing App for Mac, iPad and iPhone.
  • Zettlr - A markdown editor for the 21st century.

Note-taking

  • Affine - Affine is the next-generation collaborative knowledge base for professionals.
  • Agenda - Date-focused note taking app for both planning and documenting your projects.
  • Anytype - Local-first note-taking and knowledge management app.
  • AppFlowy - Open-source alternative to Notion.
  • Bear Writer - Beautiful, flexible writing app for crafting notes and prose.
  • Boostnote - Note-taking app made for programmers.
  • Craft - Notetaking and writing made beautiful.
  • Dnote - A simple command line notebook with multi-device sync and a web interface.
  • Email Me - Email yourself and much more with just one tap, native on macOS, iOS and WatchOS.
  • Evernote - Infamous note-taking app, available on many platforms.
  • FSNotes - File System Notes is a modern notes manager, native on macOS and iOS.
  • Gooba - Writing app and task manager with a simple and interactive design.
  • Inkdrop - Notebook app for Markdown lovers built on top of Electron.
  • Joplin - Cross-platform open-source notepad with markdown support and to-do list management.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A meticulously curated list of premium software, tools, and utilities for macOS.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Awesome Mac is an extensive, highly curated open-source repository that aggregates the best applications and tools available for the macOS ecosystem. It categorizes software across numerous domains—such as developer tools, productivity, design, and system utilities—helping users discover high-quality solutions. The project emphasizes community contributions while maintaining strict quality control, ensuring that only reliable and genuinely useful software is listed. It serves as an essential reference guide for anyone looking to optimize their Mac experience, complete with multilingual support and active sponsorships.
keyFeatures: Comprehensive Categorization: Organizes hundreds of applications into clear, intuitive categories for rapid discovery.
Strict Quality Control: Maintains high standards by rigorously reviewing community submissions to ensure software quality.
Developer and Power User Focus: Includes extensive sections dedicated to terminal utilities, programming environments, and automation tools.
Multilingual Support: Offers the curated lists in multiple languages, making the resource accessible to a global audience.
Active Community: Benefits from continuous updates, sponsorships, and contributions from macOS enthusiasts worldwide.

useCases.title: New Mac Setup
useCases.description: Serve as a definitive checklist for developers and power users configuring a new macOS environment from scratch.

useCases.title: Tool Discovery
useCases.description: Help users find specialized utilities and applications to solve specific workflow or productivity bottlenecks.

useCases.title: Open-Source Alternatives
useCases.description: Provide high-quality, free alternatives to costly commercial software across various creative and technical domains.

useCases.title: Workflow Optimization
useCases.description: Identify system management and automation tools that enhance the overall macOS user experience and efficiency.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This resource is invaluable for macOS users of all skill levels, from casual users looking for specific utilities to software developers setting up complex workspaces. It is particularly useful for those transitioning to macOS.
